phrase.zh: 大画幅数字电影机质感，宽容度高、肤色自然、高光过渡柔和
phrase.en: large-format digital cinema look with wide latitude, natural skin tones and soft highlight roll-off

phrase.zh: 35mm 电影胶片质感，颗粒细腻、色彩温润、对比柔和
phrase.en: 35mm motion-picture film look with fine grain, warm colour and gentle contrast

phrase.zh: 16mm 胶片质感，颗粒明显、轻微暗角、略带复古色偏
phrase.en: 16mm film look with visible grain, slight vignetting and a vintage colour cast

phrase.zh: 手机纪实拍摄质感，画面清晰锐利、景深较深、色彩真实
phrase.en: smartphone documentary look: crisp, deep focus and true-to-life colour

phrase.zh: 复古 CCD 数码相机质感，饱和度略高、轻微噪点、高光容易溢出
phrase.en: vintage CCD digicam look with slightly high saturation, light noise and blooming highlights

phrase.zh: 球面定焦镜头，成像锐利、畸变小
phrase.en: spherical prime lens, sharp with low distortion

phrase.zh: 变形宽银幕镜头，椭圆形焦外、水平拉丝光晕
phrase.en: anamorphic lens with oval bokeh and horizontal streak flares

phrase.zh: 复古镜头，边缘略软、对比偏低、光晕柔和
phrase.en: vintage glass with soft edges, lower contrast and a gentle glow

phrase.zh: 微距镜头，极近对焦，纹理细节清晰
phrase.en: macro lens focusing very close with crisp texture detail

phrase.zh: 鱼眼镜头，超广视角、明显的桶形畸变
phrase.en: fisheye lens with an ultra-wide view and strong barrel distortion
